visual.general_description: Grayscale axial contrast-enhanced abdominal CT slice with a red arrow pointing at bright calcifications in the pancreatic region.
visual.detailed_description: Single axial CT image through the upper abdomen at the level of the kidneys. The large homogeneous liver occupies the left of the image, the vertebral body and spinal canal are centered posteriorly, and both kidneys are seen posterolaterally, the one on the right of the image showing contrast enhancement with a visible renal pelvis. Anterior to the aorta and vessels, a chain of very bright, dense punctate and linear foci runs along the expected course of the pancreatic body and tail. A red arrow in the right-upper part of the image points to the brightest of these foci. A gas- and fluid-containing stomach lies anterior and to the right of the image. No text, labels, scale bar or measurement lines are visible.
